phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: It will take at least 1 year to reach the final result of rhinoplasty surgery. phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: The body of an adult human has a fixed number of fat cells. After adolescence, the quantity of fat cells doesn't increase, however the volume of fat cells increases. This outcome in weight gain. Dietary habits and way of life are the main variables in people groups' weight reduction. Legitimate eating routine and exercise and an ordinary way of life are fundamental to dispose of overabundance weight. Nonetheless, even individuals who meet these circumstances might have determined (static) fat stores that don't vanish.
phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: Areas of fat buildup that are mostly found in the middle of the body, such as the belly, waist, hips, outside and inner sides of the thigh, and knees, are resistant to diet and exercise. Diet and exercise can help reduce excess fat in these locations, but doing more of either causes the metabolism of the body as a whole to deteriorate rather than thin down the fat in these areas. Liposuction is the most efficient way to remove fat from these locations.

phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: When doing liposuction surgery, the region of recalcitrant fat is initially inflated with an injection of a unique liquid (tumescent). Then, a few mm-long incisions are performed on or close to this location. Depending on the patient's health, metal tubes called "cannula" with a diameter of 2–6 mm are introduced from these incisions into the subcutaneous layer and attached to the vacuum device. By inserting the cannulas at the proper depth in the fat accumulation regions that have been made harder with tumescent solution, breaking apart, and sucking with the grating logic, excess fats first begin to be extracted. The process of absorbing the fats by means of vacuum continues until the desired body contour and a smooth skin surface are achieved.
phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: This procedure is referred to as traditional (classic) liposuction and is entirely dependent on manual dexterity and arm strength. Today, the power-assisted liposuction technique, in which the cannula vibrates automatically with the help of a device, has also been used in order to facilitate and speed up the process. Both laser (Laser liposuction) and ultrasound (Vaser liposuction) intensities have been employed recently. These two procedures have lower rates of complications such as discomfort, bleeding, tissue damage, and fluctuation than the standard (traditional) procedure, and the postoperative skin tightens more effectively.

phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: Autologous stem cells, specifically mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) derived from a person's tissues, have been explored for their potential use in hair transplants and hair restoration. This approach aims to harness the regenerative properties of stem cells to stimulate hair growth and improve the outcomes of traditional hair transplantation procedures.
phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: As with any medical intervention, individuals considering autologous stem cell-based treatments for hair transplants should consult with qualified healthcare professionals, such as dermatologists or hair restoration specialists, to discuss the potential risks, benefits, and personalized treatment plans based on current scientific knowledge and individual health considerations.In some cases, stem cells used for hair loss treatment are derived from the patient's own body, typically from adipose tissue (fat) or bone marrow. This is known as autologous stem cell therapy.

phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: The laser skin resurfacing process begins with an initial consultation, where a qualified practitioner evaluates the patient's skin type, concerns, and aesthetic goals to create a personalized treatment plan. On the day of the procedure, the skin is cleansed, and a topical anesthetic is applied to minimize discomfort. The practitioner then uses either an ablative laser, which removes the outer layers of skin for deeper rejuvenation, or a non-ablative laser, which targets the underlying skin without removing the surface, stimulating collagen production.
phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: The procedure typically lasts from 30 minutes to two hours, depending on the area treated. Afterward, patients may experience redness and swelling, like a sunburn, and are given detailed aftercare instructions to promote healing, which includes keeping the skin moisturized and protected from sun exposure. Optimal results develop over several weeks, with improvements in texture and tone lasting for months to years, depending on the technique used and proper maintenance.

phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: The recovery process after laser skin resurfacing varies depending on the type of laser used, but generally involves several stages. Immediately following the procedure, patients may experience redness, swelling, and a sensation similar to sunburn, which can last for a few days. During the first week, the skin may peel or crust as it heals, and it's crucial to keep it moisturized with recommended ointments or gentle products.
phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part2_text: Patients should avoid strenuous activities and sun exposure, using high-SPF sunscreen to protect the healing skin. Improvement in skin texture and appearance usually becomes more noticeable over the following weeks to months as collagen production increases. Follow-up appointments with the practitioner allow for monitoring progress and addressing any concerns, ensuring a smooth and effective recovery to achieve optimal results.

phase2_priorityB_paragraph_splits.part1_text: Cancer treatment in Turkey is significantly more affordable compared to the United States and many European countries, making it an attractive option for medical tourists.
